text_block_list.text: Early October. Late at night.

Win Variation had received a leave pass 
and was in the Trainer's Office. Along 
with Verxina,

Together with her younger sisters, Cheval 
Grand and Verxina. And the reason for that 
is—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the paddock...! She's on screen right 
now, Orfe-san!

Indeed, it was to watch Orfevre run in the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~! No matter how many times I look at 
it, this lineup is totally stacked♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Running in a crowd like this... N-Now even 
I'm starting to get nervous...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—My word. I heard Orfevre-san couldn't 
bring her Japanese staff this time and 
traveled to France almost entirely on her 
own.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It was decided that almost everything—from 
daily needs to racecourse guidance—would 
be handled by local staff.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Wait, nobody tried to stop them?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... it seems she herself 
flatly stated that it wouldn't be a 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? That's amazing... Though I 
guess that sounds just like Orfe-san—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something the matter?

As her gaze suddenly drops down to my 
legs, I get a bad feeling.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...A-Actually... for a little while now... 
...my leg has been, just a bit...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...It's painful, or rather...

If it's the nighttime clinic affiliated 
with the academy, they should still be 
able to take her in.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
B-But it only hurts a little bit...! It'd 
be a bother to go for just this.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"That is not true. These legs are 
delicate... Even the slightest discomfort 
could lead to a major injury."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I mean, yeah, but... still...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...

I'm torn. But as a Trainer, Win 
Variation's physical and mental well-being 
must come first.
choice_data_list:
Sorry, let's watch the recording together 
later!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... Yes!

And so, we rushed straight into the 
hospital—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
... There is some inflammation in your 
left ankle.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
If you get some rest, we can expect a full 
recovery. Take a break from training for a 
while... or keep the workload as minimal 
as possible.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um...! The Arima Kinen is coming up, will 
we make it in time for that!?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, late December—as long as you rest 
properly, running the race isn't out of 
the question.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: In that case—!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it's the Arima Kinen, after all. 
Especially this year, since it's 
Orfevre-san's final domestic run."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"A high-intensity race is expected. As for 
conditioning her body enough to win... 
honestly, putting that much strain on her 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
P-P-Please wait! Her final run... in 
Japan...?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. It seems that was mentioned earlier 
during the Prix de l'Arc de Triompheâ

According to the doctor's explanation, 
this was the situation.

The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—a 
heartbreaking 2nd-place finish. Truly just 
a hair's breadth away from victory.

At a racetrack filled with a mix of 
jubilation and despair... Whatever Orfevre 
was thinking, she suddenly spoke to the 
interviewer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
At next year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
I shall part the dark clouds and bestow 
supreme radiance. Accept it with 
reverence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we shall move our base of 
operations to Europe next year. —Prepare 
yourself mentally. This is a royal decree.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I-In other words, do you intend to 
challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
again next year...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Then, then what about the races in 
Japan—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
... The curtain will fall at the Arima 
Kinen.

Apparently, the specific reasons behind 
why she made that decision were never 
shared.

She had overcome her suffering and stepped 
up to the Arima Kinen. Determined to steal 
the spotlight, she had begun charging 
powerfully forward.

If it were just an injury, I could've 
moved on and told myself there's always 
next time, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Not like this...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, excuse me! I'll be... taking my 
leave for today...

Watching her walk away briskly... I had no 
idea what to say to her.

—To Win Variation, Orfevre was the very 
embodiment of her admiration. That is 
precisely why she had staked everything on 
the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list:
(If only I could at least fight with 
everything I've got—)

text_block_list.text:
Balancing treatment and training side by 
side, while still bringing the body into 
peak condition. That day was spent 
entirely searching for such a possibility.
And the following day—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me, would it be all right if we 
did pool training today?"
That was the email I received.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, good morning! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the suddenness. I just finished 
doing a walking lap, and—

Her positive demeanor is a complete 
turnaround from yesterday, and the shock 
of it is impossible to hide.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Sorry, that must have surprised you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, it's not like I've 
completely shifted gears yet."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, our luck is just way too bad, 
y'know? Just when I thought I was ready, 
they go and run a race with zero 
motivation—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Just when I thought she had finally gotten 
her motivation back, something like this 
happens... An injury is bad enough, but 
knowing her next race will be her last in 
Japan...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Why she even brought that up in the first 
place, I have no clue...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Even so, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If the next one's really the end, then no 
matter what, I have to make it in time and 
steal the spotlight...!

As she faced straight ahead and said so, 
her voice was trembling.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it either, but...! The 
one thing I definitely don't have time for 
is being down in the dumps...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So... Trainer! Could you gather as much 
training as possible that we can still do 
even under these conditions?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do everything I possibly can...! 
And then, I'm definitely gonna settle the 
score...!

...To be honest, it won't be easy. It even 
carries risks. She probably understands 
that full well.

"Yet, if she—who must be suffering the 
most— is trying so hard to move 
forward..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much!

Afterward, I made a second promise with 
Win Variation.

Let injuries heal completely. Take extreme 
care not to let them worsen.

On top of that, winning the Arima Kinen 
and stealing the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. The bouquet has to be nothing 
short of perfection.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'd hate it if you went over there and 
forgot about me right away, after all.

The end of the year is just around the 
corner.
